## Tutorials

The SQUARE() function returns the square of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SQUARE(64);

---

SQUARE(
number
)

---

SELECT SQUARE(13);
```

## Tutorials

The SUM() function calculates the sum of a set of values.

Note:NULL values are ignored.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT SUM(Quantity) AS TotalItemsOrdered FROM OrderDetails;

---

SUM(
expression
)
```

## Tutorials

The TAN() function returns the tangent of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT TAN(1.75);

---

TAN(
number
)

---

SELECT TAN(-3);
```

## Tutorials

The CURRENT_TIMESTAMP function returns the current date and time, in a 
'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.mmm' format.

Tip:Also look at theGETDATE()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

---

CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
```

## Tutorials

The DATEADD() function adds a time/date interval to a date and then returns the date.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT DATEADD(year, 1, '2017/08/25') AS DateAdd;

---

DATEADD(
interval
,
number
,
date
)

---

SELECT DATEADD(month, 2, '2017/08/25') AS DateAdd;

---

SELECT DATEADD(month, -2, '2017/08/25') AS DateAdd;

---

SELECT LastName, 
  BirthDate, DATEADD(year, 18, BirthDate) AS DateAdd FROM Employees;
```
